brief: Nasdaq 100 futures are up roughly 1.7% before the open as AI and chip names (Nvidia, AMD, Micron, CoreWeave) rebound from Tuesday's hot-CPI selloff, and VIX is down about 6%. The dollar is notably firmer (EURUSD -0.66%, USDJPY +0.55%), a headwind for tech. The Treasury cash market is closed for Veterans Day, so the yield factor is scored 0, but the 10-year closed Tuesday near 4.98% after a 10 bp jump. The key risk for the session is the rate backdrop: markets are pricing elevated odds of a December hike, and a gap this large can fade if yields or the dollar keep rising.

sources.title: Yahoo Finance: Stock market today, Nov 11
